A Busy Day in the Park

Present Continuous

It is shining brightly, and the birds are singing in the big oak tree. In the city park, many people are enjoying their day off.

A young woman named Lily is sitting on a green bench. She is reading a thick book. Next to her, a little boy is playing with his red ball. He is throwing the ball up and is catching it. His mother is watching him and is smiling.

At the same time, two old men are sitting at a stone table. They are playing chess. One man is moving his queen, and the other man is thinking about his next move. They are drinking hot tea from small cups.

Near the lake, some ducks are swimming in the water. A family is feeding the ducks with old bread. The children are laughing and are pointing at the big, white duck. The duck is eating all the bread very quickly.

Suddenly, the little boy's red ball is flying through the air. It is going towards the lake! The boy is running after it, but his mother is calling him back. "Stop, Tom! Don't go near the water!"

Just then, a young man on a bicycle is riding past the lake. He is seeing the ball and is stopping his bike. He is picking up the ball and is bringing it back to the boy. The boy is smiling and is saying, "Thank you!"

While all this is happening, Lily is still reading her book. She is not watching the ducks or the boy. She is enjoying her quiet time.

The afternoon is passing, and the park is getting busier. At 5 o'clock, everyone is leaving. Lily is closing her book and is standing up. The old men are finishing their chess game. The family is packing their picnic basket.

Later tonight, Lily is going to be thinking about her lovely day in the park. And tomorrow, she will be reading another book on the same bench!

❓ Answer these questions (Present Continuous):
  1. What is Lily doing?
  2. What are the birds doing?
  3. What are the two old men doing?
  4. What is the little boy doing with his ball?
  5. What are the ducks doing?
🌞 Present Continuous 🕰️ Past Continuous 🔮 Future Continuous
🌿🐦🍃
📌 Все длительные действия в настоящем — выделены зелёно-кофейным.
📖 Формула: am/is/are + Ving

A Rainy Evening at Home

Past Continuous

Last night, the rain was falling heavily outside. The wind was blowing through the trees, and the windows were shaking a little. It was getting darker and darker.

Inside the house, the whole family was spending a quiet evening. Mum was cooking soup in the kitchen. She was chopping vegetables and was stirring the pot very carefully.

Dad was sitting in his big armchair. He was reading a newspaper, but he was not paying much attention. He was listening to the rain on the roof.

The two children, Emma and Jack, were playing on the living room floor. They were building a castle with colourful blocks. Emma was putting red blocks on top, and Jack was arranging the blue ones around the castle.

Their old dog, Max, was sleeping near the fireplace. He was dreaming about something, because his paws were moving and he was making little sounds. Sometimes he was wagging his tail slowly.

Suddenly, the lights went out! Everything became dark. Everyone stopped what they were doing.

Mum was looking for a candle in the drawer. Dad was searching for his phone to use the torch. The children were laughing because they were feeling a little scared but also excited.

While Dad was finding the candles, Mum was lighting them one by one. Soon, the room was glowing with a warm, soft light. The family was sitting around the table, and they were telling stories by candlelight.

Outside, the rain was still falling, but inside, everyone was feeling cosy and happy. They were enjoying this special evening together. Nobody was missing the TV or the internet!

At 10 o'clock, the lights came back on. But the family was still sitting together. They were talking and were drinking hot chocolate. The children were not going to bed yet — they were having too much fun!

Later that night, when everyone was asleep, the rain was still falling. It was singing its quiet song on the roof all night long.

❓ Answer these questions (Past Continuous):
  1. What was Mum doing in the kitchen?
  2. What was Dad doing?
  3. What were the children doing?
  4. What was the dog, Max, doing?
  5. What was happening outside?
🌙 Past Continuous (основное) 📖 Past Simple (связки)
🏠🕯️🐕
📌 Все длительные действия в прошлом — выделены сине-кофейным. Короткие действия (связки) — нейтральным.
📖 Формула: was/were + Ving

Every Morning in the Johnson Family

Present Simple

Every morning, the Johnson family wakes up at 6:30. The sun rises early, and the birds sing outside the window. It is a new day!

Mr. Johnson gets up first. He goes to the kitchen and makes coffee. He drinks his coffee slowly and reads the morning news on his phone.

Mrs. Johnson stays in bed for five more minutes. Then she gets up, goes to the bathroom, and takes a quick shower. She puts on her favourite yellow dress.

Their son, Tom, does not like mornings. He stays under the blanket and pretends to sleep. But his mum comes into his room and opens the curtains. "Tom, are you awake?" she asks.

Their daughter, Emma, jumps out of bed immediately. She loves mornings! She brushes her hair, puts on her school uniform, and runs downstairs to the kitchen.

At 7:15, the whole family sits at the breakfast table. They eat toast with jam, have cereal with milk, and drink fresh orange juice. They talk about their plans for the day.

Tom does not eat much. He prefers to play with his toast. Emma eats everything quickly because she wants to go to school early.

After breakfast, Mr. Johnson washes the dishes. Mrs. Johnson packs the children's lunch boxes. She puts an apple, a sandwich, and a small biscuit in each box.

At 8:00, the children leave for school. They walk to the bus stop together. The bus arrives at 8:10, and they get on it. Tom waves to his mum from the window.

Mr. Johnson works from home. He goes to his home office and starts his computer. He answers emails and has online meetings.

Mrs. Johnson goes to the supermarket. She buys fresh bread, milk, and vegetables. She meets her friend, Anna, and they drink coffee together at a small cafe.

In the evening, the family comes back together. They have dinner at 7:00. They tell each other about their day. Emma shows her good marks from school. Tom talks about his football practice.

Every night at 10:00, everyone goes to bed. The Johnsons read books before sleep. They turn off the lights and dream about tomorrow. Tomorrow is a new day!

❓ Answer these questions (Present Simple):
  1. What time does the Johnson family wake up?
  2. What does Mr. Johnson do first?
  3. What does Emma do in the morning?
  4. Where does Mrs. Johnson go after breakfast?
  5. What does the family do in the evening?
🌅 Present Simple (действия) 📘 to be (глагол-связка)
🏡☕📚
📌 Все действия, которые происходят каждый день — выделены оранжево-кофейным. Глагол to be (am/is/are) — нейтральным.
📖 Формула: V1 / V1+s (для he/she/it)  |  am/is/are
🏖️

A Summer Day at the Beach

Past Simple

Last summer, my family and I went to the beach. It was a hot and sunny day. The sky was blue, and the water was warm and calm.

We arrived at the beach at 10 o'clock in the morning. We parked the car and carried our bags to the sand. My dad placed a big umbrella near the water.

My mum spread a large blanket on the sand. She took out sandwiches, fruit, and cold drinks. We ate breakfast together and drank fresh lemonade.

My little brother, Tom, ran straight to the water. He jumped into the sea and started swimming. He was so happy!

I decided to build a sandcastle. I used a big bucket and a small shovel. I filled the bucket with wet sand and turned it upside down. I made towers and walls. My sandcastle was beautiful!

My dad went for a swim. He swam far into the sea. He saw some small fish in the water. He came back and told us about the fish.

My mum stayed on the blanket. She read her favourite magazine. She listened to music on her phone. She relaxed and enjoyed the sun.

At 1 o'clock, we had lunch. We ate sandwiches, drank juice, and ate some fresh fruit. We talked and laughed a lot.

After lunch, we played beach volleyball. My dad and I played against my mum and Tom. We won the game! Tom cried a little, but we gave him some ice cream.

In the afternoon, we walked along the beach. We collected beautiful shells. I found a big pink shell. Tom found a small white one. We put them in our bag.

At 5 o'clock, the weather changed. The wind started blowing. Dark clouds appeared in the sky. We decided to go home.

We packed our things quickly. We cleaned the beach. We took all our rubbish with us. We walked back to the car.

On the way home, we stopped at a small cafe. We ate ice cream and drank cold cola. We talked about our favourite moments of the day.

That evening, I looked at my shells. I remembered all the fun we had. It was a perfect summer day. I felt so happy and relaxed.

Before bed, I wrote about the day in my diary. I wrote: "Today was the best day of the summer. I loved every minute of it!"

❓ Answer these questions (Past Simple):
  1. Where did the family go last summer?
  2. What did the narrator build?
  3. What did Dad see in the water?
  4. What did the family do after lunch?
  5. What did the narrator write in the diary?
🏄 Past Simple (действия) 📘 to be (was/were)
🌊🐚☀️
📌 Все действия, которые закончились в прошлом — выделены красно-кофейным. Глагол to be (was/were) — нейтральным.
📖 Формула: V2 / V+ed  |  was/were

Tomorrow's Big Adventure

Future Simple + Future Cont.

Tomorrow will be an exciting day! My best friend Lucy and I will go on a big adventure. We will visit a new theme park called "Magic World". I will meet Lucy at the station at 8 AM.

At 9 AM, we will be travelling on the train. While we will be sitting on the train, we will look at the beautiful countryside. We will take lots of photos and will share them with our families.

When we will arrive at the park, we will buy our tickets. The park will open at 10 AM. We will be so happy!

First, we will go on the biggest roller coaster. While we will be riding the roller coaster, we will be screaming with joy! I know Lucy will be holding my hand very tightly.

At 12 o'clock, we will be having lunch at a nice restaurant. The waiter will bring us pizza and lemonade. While we will be eating, a clown will perform funny tricks for us. We will laugh a lot.

In the afternoon, we will visit the water park. We will swim in the big pool and will slide down the water slides. While we will be swimming, the sun will be shining brightly. We will be having so much fun!

At 3 PM, we will watch a dolphin show. The dolphins will jump through hoops and will catch balls. While the dolphins will be performing, we will be clapping and cheering. I will take a video of the show.

At 5 PM, we will go to the souvenir shop. I will buy a small dolphin toy for my little sister. Lucy will buy a T-shirt with the park's logo. While we will be choosing our souvenirs, the shop assistant will help us.

In the evening, we will watch a beautiful fireworks show. The fireworks will light up the night sky. While the fireworks will be exploding in the air, everyone will be looking up and smiling. It will be magical!

We will leave the park at 9 PM. We will take the last train home. While we will be travelling back, we will be talking about our favourite moments. I think we will be feeling tired but very happy.

When we will get home, I will call Lucy to say goodnight. We will promise to go on another adventure soon. Tomorrow will be a day to remember!

❓ Answer these questions (Future Simple / Continuous):
  1. Where will Lucy and the narrator go tomorrow?
  2. What will they do at 9 AM?
  3. What will they do on the roller coaster?
  4. What will they watch at 3 PM?
  5. What will they do while they are travelling back home?
🚀 Future Simple (will + V1) ⏳ Future Continuous (will be + Ving)
⭐🌈🎆
📌 Future Simple (фиолетово-кофейный) — короткие действия, обещания, планы. Future Continuous (голубо-кофейный) — длительные действия в определённый момент в будущем.
📖 Сравнение:
Future Simple: will + V1
Future Continuous: will be + Ving
